from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the current paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that appear in this paper's bibliography/references section")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
